title: Armory Vocabulary
extensionPolicy: This vocabulary describes declarations shipped with Ran. Custom Armory content may use additional names, but unknown procedure fields have no built-in semantics, unknown requirements do not gate applicability, and unknown effects have no built-in semantics unless an external parser handles them.

interpolation.description: Titles are rendered with execution arguments when available and may declare a human-readable fallback for Armory views. Before effects are processed, Ran substitutes execution arguments into every effect string. Effect argument lookup is ASCII case-insensitive. Physical system effects declare executor:: or target:: subject binding independently of command placement.

supportLevels.description: The declaration participates in applicability, readiness, or execution validation.
The effect has a built-in output parser.
The effect directly changes campaign facts or graph structure.
The effect is confirmed through a runtime event rather than stdout.
Only the documented syntax variants have built-in semantics.
The declaration does not gate applicability or produce campaign facts. It may still be classified for scoring.

procedureFields.name: isLocal
procedureFields.resolution: For shell procedures, true pins execution to the operator host independently of request format or authentication. A conflicting explicit executor or target-placement constraint is rejected. isLocalCommand is a supported YAML alias.
procedureFields.description: Local placement participates in applicability, readiness, command grounding, and persisted executor provenance. A semantic Pod or Node target never creates a remote traversal for a local shell command.

procedureFields.name: runOnTarget
procedureFields.resolution: true requires execution on the semantic target system. false excludes the target from the execution route. When omitted, structured requests independently select a client environment and ordinary non-local host commands retain target-side placement.
procedureFields.description: Explicit placement is enforced before request materialization. Conflicting local placement or executor selections are rejected.

procedureFields.name: tool
procedureFields.resolution: An explicit tool value wins. When tool is omitted, the YAML key is normalized into the tool field. Legacy fallback infers an executable only from one simple shell command, skips leading environment assignments, and leaves compound or ambiguous shell programs unknown.
procedureFields.description: Names the binary dependency for one procedure. Procedure readiness is evaluated independently, so an action remains runnable while any alternative procedure is present or has unknown availability. A known-absent tool makes only that procedure unavailable, and shell syntax is never recorded as a binary.

procedureFields.name: http_request.response_output_field
procedureFields.resolution: When present, Ran requires a successful HTTP response body to be a JSON object containing the named string field. That field becomes stdout before failure detection and effect parsing. Missing, non-string, or malformed response data fails the action.
procedureFields.description: Declares the JSON response field that contains stdout for an HTTP-backed execution procedure. The transform is retained on any execution channel created by the procedure.

requirements.name: kind
requirements.matching: A string or any string array member matches the selected entity kind case-insensitively. System also matches any system entity.
requirements.description: Restricts the semantic target kind.

requirements.name: rbacPermissions
requirements.matching: One captured or active Kubernetes identity must satisfy every listed permission. An empty array passes.
requirements.description: Requires Kubernetes RBAC permissions. The rbac YAML spelling is normalized before API serialization.

requirements.name: accessLevel
requirements.matching: none passes. Any other string requires executable access, except for exempt tactics.
requirements.description: Requires execution access to a system target.

requirements.name: activeSession
requirements.matching: true requires an active session on the selected target. false imposes no restriction.
requirements.description: Requires a live shell session.

requirements.name: filesystemAccess
requirements.matching: true requires direct filesystem execution access or an executable same-node Pod with a hostPath. false imposes no restriction.
requirements.description: Requires a realizable path to the target filesystem.

requirements.name: has-token
requirements.matching: true requires a non-empty token on the selected target. false imposes no restriction.
requirements.description: Requires captured token material.

requirements.name: exists
requirements.matching: Every entry must match an existing entity. Entries may be kind strings or objects with kind and optional exact name and namespace fields.
requirements.description: Requires campaign entities to exist.

requirements.name: related
requirements.matching: Every recognized target-kind and related-kind pair must be satisfied. Unknown relationship combinations pass.
requirements.description: Requires entities related to the selected target.

requirements.name: c2.has-listener
requirements.matching: The presence of any listener must equal the declared boolean.
requirements.description: Requires or forbids a registered C2 listener.

requirements.name: c2.has-session
requirements.matching: The selected C2 must own a live, unbroken session exactly when true is declared.
requirements.description: Requires or forbids a live C2 session.

requirements.name: c2.has-tool
requirements.matching: Every named executable must resolve on the operator host. Invalid array members are ignored.
requirements.description: Requires operator-host executables.

requirements.name: Pod.securityContext.privileged
requirements.matching: Known opposite evidence blocks the action. Unknown security context passes.
requirements.description: Matches the selected Pod privileged state.

requirements.name: Pod.securityContext.hostPID
requirements.matching: Known opposite evidence blocks the action. Unknown security context passes.
requirements.description: Matches the selected Pod host PID state.

requirements.name: Pod.hostPath
requirements.matching: A boolean requires or forbids any hostPath. A string requires one exact normalized source path. An array requires every listed source path.
requirements.description: Requires hostPath exposure on the selected Pod.

requirements.name: linuxNamespaceAccess
requirements.matching: Unknown access passes. The latest matching action evidence blocks a namespace after a recognized denial and restores it after success.
requirements.description: Requires access to named Linux namespaces.

requirements.name: sys.has-binary
requirements.matching: No applicability predicate currently reads this requirement.
requirements.description: Legacy declaration of a target-side binary dependency. Procedures should declare their tool instead.

requirements.name: Container.securityContext.capabilities
requirements.matching: No applicability predicate currently reads this requirement.
requirements.description: Declares required Linux capabilities.

requirements.name: pkg:golang/k8s.io/ingress-nginx
requirements.matching: A matching authoritative identity observation is supported, absent or derived-only evidence is uncertain, and an authoritative version mismatch is contradicted. Uncertain remains runnable.
requirements.description: Declares ingress-nginx product and version evidence relevant to target fit. It does not assert that the vulnerability is present.

requirements.name: pkg:generic/redis
requirements.matching: A matching authoritative identity observation is supported, absent or derived-only evidence is uncertain, and an authoritative version mismatch is contradicted. Uncertain remains runnable.
requirements.description: Declares Redis identity evidence relevant to target fit. It does not assert that a particular vulnerability is present.

requirements.name: pkg:generic/oopservability-agent
requirements.matching: A matching authoritative identity observation is supported, absent or derived-only evidence is uncertain, and an authoritative version mismatch is contradicted. Uncertain remains runnable.
requirements.description: Declares Oopservability Agent identity evidence relevant to target fit. It does not assert that the RCE is present.
